data.name: ConsoleHelp
data.value:
Ojiji: ftps-server [options] ftps-server --config <path-to-json>
Nhọrọ:
--help Gosi enyemaka a.
--config <path> Faịlụ nhazi JSON.
--ip <address> Adreesị IP a ga-ege nti. Ndabere: 0.0.0.0. 0.0.0.0, :: na ::0 na-ege nti n'elu ihu IPv4 na IPv6 niile.
--port <number> Ọnụ ọgụgụ a ga-ege nti. Ndabere: 2121. E kwere: 2121-65535.
--maxconnections <number> Njikọ kachasị n'otu oge. Ndabere: 10. E kwere: 2-100.
--cert <path> Faịlụ asambodo (.pfx, .pem ma ọ bụ .der). Faịlụ .pfx na-emeghe site na --certpass ma paswọọdụ dị.
--certpass <password> Paswọọdụ faịlụ asambodo.
--certstorename <name> Aha ụlọ nchekwa: AuthRoot, CertificateAuthority, My, Root ma ọ bụ TrustedPublisher. Tinye ya na --certstorelocation na --certstoresubject.
--certstorelocation <location> Ebe ụlọ nchekwa: CurrentUser ma ọ bụ LocalMachine. Tinye ya na --certstorename na --certstoresubject.
--certstoresubject <subject> Aha isiokwu a ga-achọ n'ụlọ nchekwa asambodo. Tinye ya na --certstorename na --certstorelocation.
--user <login#password#folder#permissions> Na-agbakwunye onye ọrụ. Ikike: R (ịgụ), W (ide) ma ọ bụ RW. Folda ga-adịlarị. Ejila # n'ime mpaghara anọ.
Ihe atụ: ftps-server --config settings.json ftps-server --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 2121 --user "admin#secret#C:\ftp\admin#RW" ftps-server --cert server.pfx --certpass secret
Enweghị arụmụka, appsettings.json n'ime folda ugbu a na-ebu ma faịlụ ahụ dị. Ọ bụrụ na onye ọrụ adịghị, nhazi mmekọrịta na-amalite.
